date.as_written: śāke dvicandrā śvarasābhiyukte māsyur j-jake pāṃḍurapakṣa bhinne dale tithau vedamukhasya ... prabhākarevāsarake

notes: No personal names are given in the colophon (the scribe is only referred to as 'dhīmān ... lilekha'). The catalogue lists donors Hemanārāyaṇapaṇḍita and Śeṣānanda, likely recorded in an ownership note or stamp elsewhere on the manuscript.
